result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales-rep list uses.

The change is one line in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: `findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` now calls `.highestPriorityFirst()` on its query, the same way the sales-rep method does. I also updated that method's Javadoc to describe the new order. `RegionManagerService.overviewFor` picks this up without changes.

`RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest`, `DashboardTest` and `TicketsPerRegionTest` pass offline. I did not add a test that asserts the T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1 example, so that ordering is verified only by the existing suite and by reading the SQL. Nothing is committed.
